description: Search long-form podcast and conference episodes (AI, investing, crypto, startups, macro) by keyword, person, topic or date. Returns each match's title, people, date, topics, editorial summary, matching chapters and links to the full Markdown text and YouTube. Use `person` to answer 'which podcasts has X appeared on and what did they talk about'. Summaries are mostly in Chinese.

person.description: Host or guest name, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Sam Altman'. Exact name first, then partial match.

query.description: Keywords; every space-separated word must match title, people, topics, chapters or summary. Text is mostly Chinese, so give English and Chinese spellings joined by | (either may match), e.g. 'stablecoin|稳定币 regulation|监管' or 'robotics|机器人'.

topic.description: Topic or series name from list_topics, e.g. 'AI 智能体' or 'OpenAI'.

name: search_episodes
